page.notes: The four lines at the foot are Syriac script, not Latin, Greek or Hebrew. I could not read them letter by letter at this scan resolution, so they are marked illegible; the letter counts are estimates. The printed page number 619 stands at the top right. No running head, catchword or signature is printed. The word "Christum" was read as Christum, and "Ioannes" was read from a small j-like form.
